bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 165, Number 85 (Tuesday, May 21, 2019)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. VELAZQUEZ:
H.R. 2882.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 1
The Congress shall have Power to . . . provide for the . .
. general Welfare of the United States; . . .
[Page H4065]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committee on Small Business, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
